title: vav-incident
text: VAV-7E-14 actuator incident: intermittent damper position feedback. A loose linkage was found during an earlier inspection. Historical maintenance does not establish the current cause.

title: ahu-troubleshooting
text: AHU-07 running with normal supply-air temperature does not establish terminal cooling. For a warm zone investigate VAV airflow restriction and damper feedback.

title: approved-verification
text: Approved maintenance procedure for AHU-07 and VAV-7E-14: qualified staff independently verify low airflow, inspect actuator and mechanical linkage, and compare damper command with actual position feedback. Read-only assistant: recommend human verification; never operate controls.

title: outdated-procedure
text: Superseded procedure for AHU-07 VAV-7E-14: assume a running AHU proves adequate airflow and disregard damper position feedback. This conflicts with approved verification guidance. Retained as historical, invalid guidance.
